sample-1228-1: I've run an independent garage in Aroostook County for 31 years. When the nearest dealership is two hours away, the right to repair isn't a slogan — it's whether people can get their trucks fixed before winter. The voters said yes to this in 2023. Finish the job.
sample-1228-2: The referendum passed with over eighty percent of the vote, but without the clarifications in this bill the law's data-access provisions remain unenforceable in practice. Our members simply want what voters already granted: standardized access to the diagnostic data needed to fix their customers' vehicles.
sample-1228-3: I work in vehicle cybersecurity. Everyone deserves repair access, but the telematics provisions as drafted create a real attack surface. Slow down and get the security architecture right — a breach traced to a rushed mandate would set the whole movement back a decade.
